name: Rhode Island

flag.description: A white field with a gold anchor in the centre, encircled by 13 gold stars, with a blue ribbon below the anchor bearing the word "HOPE" in gold.
flag.symbolism: The anchor is a symbol of hope, and the 13 stars stand for the original colonies; Rhode Island was the 13th to ratify the Constitution.

hook: Rhode Island is the one with a gold anchor and the word HOPE on white, the opposite of a seal on a bedsheet.
trivia: The anchor and "Hope" are usually linked to the Bible verse calling hope "an anchor of the soul".
Rhode Island is the smallest US state by area, and in 2020 voters removed "and Providence Plantations" from its official name.
